decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a mix of high-end, mid-range, and ultra-portable options. The Bang & Olufsen (prod_bluetooth_speakers_195) is highly appealing for its audiophile quality, but the price is quite high. The JBL Charge 4 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_013) offers the best balance of battery life, durability, and sound quality for the price, even as a renewed item. Its high rating of 4.7 with over 1,600 reviews gives me confidence in its performance compared to the solar-powered Goal Zero or the smaller JBL Clip 3.
